q1_issues.issue: 'in the hall' restricts the permitted photography, not the act of allowing, so (Location sk_allow_1 sk_hall_1) places the wrong eventuality in the hall.

q2_gaps: a locative or circumstantial modifier belonging to an eventive-nominal object ('allows photography in the hall') — the object is stored as a bare class symbol with no witness or event, so the instruction set offers no slot to attach the modifier to it and the only available host is the matrix event

a lexical permission verb with an eventive-nominal object ('a curator allows photography') — whether it stays an ordinary event or routes to the kind-level deontic form, where 'Trailers are permitted on the causeway' puts exactly such a locative restriction in a ConditionalProperty condition slot, is unspecified
notes: 'curator' is correctly typed and stopped (referring use, so no capability atom), 'photography' correctly keeps its derived form rather than being reduced to a verb, and Theme is the right object role.
